s2.ptxt: Using SST and a hammer, tap in a new diaphragm oil seal into the rear differential carrier assembly to the standard depth.

item.ptxt: Tap the oil seal in evenly so that it goes in straight.
Do not tap the oil seal in too far.

s2.ptxt: Apply a light coat of MP grease No.2 to the oil seal lip.
Install the transmission coupling shim to the rear differential carrier assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Transmission Coupling Conical Spring Washer

s2.ptxt: Install the transmission coupling conical spring washer to the rear differential carrier assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Install the washer so that the marking (green) or protrusion faces the front of the vehicle (coupling side).

s2.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 5, install the yoke to the differential carrier assembly with the 3 bolts.
Install a new O-ring to the solenoid.
Install the solenoid to the yoke.
Using SST, install a new snap ring.
Using a scraper, clean off the seal packing adhering to the rear differential carrier and transmission coupling assembly, then remove oil with cleaning solvent or equivalent.
Apply seal packing 1281 to the area of the transmission coupling assembly shown in the illustration.

item.ptxt: Apply the seal packing in a bead of diameter φ2-3mm without any breaks.
Overlap the start and end of application by 10mm or more.
Install within 3 minutes after applying seal packing.

s2.ptxt: Install the transmission coupling assembly to the rear differential carrier assembly with the 4 bolts.
Install the rear differential support assembly No.1 and rear differential support assembly No.2 with 6 new bolts and 2 nuts.
Connect the connector.

s2.ptxt: Align the matchmarks on the transfer assembly and propeller shaft assembly.
Temporarily tighten the propeller with center bearing shaft assembly with 4 new nuts and 4 washers.
Align the matchmarks on the differential carrier assembly and propeller shaft assembly.
Temporarily tighten the propeller with center bearing shaft assembly with 4 new nuts and 4 washers.
Temporarily tighten the center support bearing assembly with the 2 bolts, with the center support bearing washers in place.

s-1.ptxt: Fully Tighten Propeller Shaft with Center Bearing Assembly

s2.ptxt: Fully tighten the 4 nuts installing the propeller shaft assembly to the transfer assembly.
Fully tighten the 4 nuts installing the propeller shaft assembly to the differential carrier assembly.
Check that the housing center line of the center support bearing assembly is at a right angle to the propeller shaft axis.
Fully tighten the 2 installation bolts of the center support bearing assembly.
Before measuring the angle, settle each part using the following procedure.

s3.ptxt: Rotate the propeller shaft several times by hand.
Place a jack under the differential and move it up and down.

atten3.ptxt: Perform the measurement in a condition as close to the vehicle being on the ground as possible, using a 4-post lift, pit or equivalent.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, measure the installation angle of the intermediate shaft assembly (A in the illustration).
Using SST, measure the installation angle between the intermediate shaft assembly (A in the illustration) and propeller shaft assembly (B in the illustration).
Using SST, measure the installation angle between the propeller shaft assembly (B in the illustration) and differential (C in the illustration).
If the result is not as specified, replace the adjusting washers at the center support bearing with appropriate ones.

item.ptxt: Use washers of the same thickness on the left and right.
Do not stack 2 washers.

Clean and degrease the bolt holes.
Set the fuel tank and 2 fuel tank bands on an engine lifter.
While operating the engine lifter, slowly install the fuel tank to the vehicle.

item.ptxt: Be careful not to drop the fuel tank.
Tilt the fuel tank while working so that it does not catch on the rear differential carrier assembly. (4WD)

s2.ptxt: Secure the fuel tank with the 4 bolts and 2 fuel tank bands.
Connect the parking brake cable with the 2 bolts.
Align the axes of the pipe and connector, and insert until a "click" sound is heard.

item.ptxt: Before working, check that there are no scratches or foreign matter on the connecting parts of the pipe and connector.
After connecting, pull on the connector and pipe to check that they are securely connected.

s2.ptxt: Align the axes of the pipe and connector, and insert until a "click" sound is heard.

item.ptxt: Before working, check that there are no scratches or foreign matter on the connecting parts of the pipe and connector.
After connecting, pull on the connector and pipe to check that they are securely connected.
After connecting, check on the top surface of the tank that the fuel hose is above the fuel tank main tube.

Connect the fuel tank breather hose as shown in the illustration, and secure it with the clamp.

Compression Spring Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using a vernier caliper, measure the free length of the compression spring.

atten3.ptxt: If it is less than the minimum, replace the spring with a new one.

s2.ptxt: Gasket Installation

s3.ptxt: Insert a new gasket into the exhaust center pipe assembly as far as it will go by hand.

item.ptxt: Do not install the gasket in the wrong direction.
Do not reuse a gasket once it has been removed.
Do not damage the gasket by dropping it, etc.
Do not damage the gasket sliding surface.
Never push the gasket in by installing the exhaust pipe without first pressing it in sufficiently by hand.

s3.ptxt: Install a new gasket to the exhaust pipe assembly front.

s2.ptxt: Install the exhaust center pipe assembly with the 3 exhaust pipe supports.
Install the exhaust center pipe assembly to the exhaust pipe assembly front with the 2 bolts.
Install the exhaust center pipe assembly to the exhaust tail pipe assembly with the bolts and 2 compression springs.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that there is no significant difference in the clearance between the flanges of the exhaust center pipe assembly and exhaust tail pipe assembly at the front, rear, left and right.
